about: Every feature of the site and the files it is made of. The Builder reads this to label checkpoints (Feature: ...) and to bring old features back. Keep it up to date: add a feature when you build one, and remove it when the feature is deleted. Patterns: * matches inside one folder, ** matches any depth.

features.name: Header with links and social icons

asked: make this height half its current hight
answers: Should we keep the same green-to-dark-green color fade, or change the colors to match the new smaller size? → Keep the colors
Would you like to add a little extra spacing (padding) around the text so it doesn't touch the edges of the screen? → Add padding
Should we center this section on the screen, or keep it aligned to the left like before? → Centered
Would you like to add a subtle shadow behind the text so it pops out from the background? → Add shadow
history.decisions: Kept the green to dark green fade, added padding, kept it centered, added a shadow.
